raw_artifact_policy: Raw CompletionSet JSON, ScoreReport JSON, databases, adapters, and local reproduction scripts are external/local artifacts under gitignored results/ or the Modal text2sql-runs Volume, not committed.
public_mode: make eval validates this tracked summary and renders the README headline table without model, GPU, network, database, or raw completion artifacts.
full_artifact_mode: Restore the external raw bundle under gitignored results/ and run make eval-full to re-score CompletionSet artifacts and render the full internal report.
notes: GRPO headline uses three seed-level runs; confidence intervals are computed over per-seed execution accuracy.
The public bundle is a compact evidence index, not the full raw result archive.
